call_points.text: Gross margin opportunity not exhausted; a 3-4% pyramid gap versus peers remains untapped.
European automotive program causes a further ~0.5% sequential revenue headwind in Q3 before normalising.
Industry growth estimated at 2%-4% or 3%-5%; Tech Mahindra expects to grow above that.
Margin gap between T&M and fixed-price projects is close to 8%; fixed-price is the biggest FY27 lever.
AI-led productivity improvement measured at 7% in programmes, a start on the fixed-price productivity push.
FY26 free cash flow $616 mn, 115% of PAT; cash and equivalents $892 mn.
Management sees no significant client decision delays after Anthropic's Claude releases, but some clients are sharpening productivity assumptions.
No AI revenue metric yet; management will work on a credible way to report it over the next quarter.
Consulting and GenAI remain the main investment areas, funded through sales, marketing, platforms and tuck-in acquisitions.

operating_notes.text: FY26 new deal wins TCV $3,794 Mn, up 41.6% YoY, the highest in five years per the company.
Q4FY26 free cash flow $99 Mn, 68% of PAT, down from $194 Mn and 131% in Q3FY26.
IT headcount 75,377, down 817 QoQ; IT utilisation 86.1% and attrition 12.1%.
FY26 large-deal wins $3,794 Mn, up 41.6% YoY, with LTM wins rising each quarter from $2,680 Mn in Q4FY25.
FY26 free cash flow $616 Mn, 115% of the dividend paid; DSO 91 days in Q4FY26.
C&B fell to 64.4% of revenue in FY26 (-250 bps); entry-level workforce 28.6% of total.
FY26 large-deal wins $3,794 mn, up 42% YoY; Q4 wins $1,073 mn, up 35% YoY.
AI-led productivity improvement measured at 7%; 95% of peak and prime accounts have GenAI offerings; 350 industry-specific agents deployed.
DSO 89 days in Q4FY26; hedge book $0.75 bn as of March 31, 2026.
Step-down subsidiary TMCG agreed to acquire 85% of Canadian firm Avant for CAD 28 million, with the remaining 15% to be acquired by June 2029.
Q1FY27 deal wins of US$1,078 million, up 33.3% YoY, the third consecutive quarter above US$1 billion, led by manufacturing and healthcare.
Hedge book US$0.72 billion at 30 June 2026, with a negative mark-to-market of US$24.85 million, of which US$14.55 million hit the P&L.
More than 350 deployable AI agents across use cases; over 65% of associates certified in the AI belt programme and 70% of eligible developers enabled with an AI pair programmer.
Acquired 100% interest in Alyis Serviços Técnicos LTDA for BRL 1.2 million (₹2.2 Cr) on July 1, 2026.
Acquired remaining 20% stake in Tech Mahindra Arabia Limited for SAR 83.7 million (₹214.8 Cr) on July 27, 2026.
Q2FY27 revenue grew 7.2% YoY in constant currency and 2.4% QoQ, with organic constant-currency growth of 7% YoY.
Q2FY27 free cash flow was US$135 million, impacted by ramp-up of new rebadged deals, with DSO at 88 days.
Hedge book was US$0.4 billion at 30 September 2026, with mark-to-market of US$13.83 million, of which US$8.7 million was recorded in the P&L.
